reviews.title: You can assemble it yourself (but it is much easier with help)
reviews.text:
Contrary to what was recommended in the instructions, I assembled this by myself. It was not easy but all you need is enough space and leverage. I suddenly remembered my O'level physics when trying to flip it over. 
Nevertheless, when I succeeded in assembling it, I was very pleased with the sofa-bed. The seating is generous and the conversion mechanism is well-designed. There was a minor quality issue - A small tear in one of the cushion fillings but once you stuff it inside the cover it ceases to matter.
Overall, I think for what I paid for it, the product is very good and meets my needs.

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Review for TORNSBORG
reviews.text: Overall, a good arm chair bed. Easy to open up and height is good for those with knee problems to get up and out of bed. But good mainly for slim persons and those who sleep on their backs. Side sleepers may have to sleep on the end without the arm chair rests or there is little space to "turn". A pity that the covers cannot be removed and washed. Suggest also pairing it with a futon of the same size (no stocks where I bought the bed online) or a mattress for those who require an extra layer - to protect the original layer since there is no cover replacement.

reviews.author: Manimaran
reviews.title: Manual installation of Portable Vertical Wall-Mounted Table
reviews.text:
I recently purchased your portable vertical wall-mounted table, which I installed on the balcony of my workshop to support an antenna unit for a satellite communication set. Overall, the product has been satisfactory and serves its purpose well.
However, I encountered one issue during installation. The manual book with diagram did not specify the recommended drill bit size or screw dimensions required to fix the table securely to the wall. This omission made the installation process less straightforward, as I had to determine the appropriate size myself.
I suggest updating the manual to include clear guidance on the recommended drill size and screw specifications. This would make installation easier and ensure customers can mount the table safely and correctly.
Thank you for your attention, and I appreciate your continued commitment to improving your products.
Sincerely,
Mani

Overall:

reviews.author: Jessie
reviews.title: GRYTTOM Cushion
reviews.text:
It has a "Gransel natural" finish—a neutral, textured look that blends well with bohemian, coastal, or scandi-minimalist styles.

In term of fabric, it’s a mix of cotton, viscose, polyester, and linen. This gives it a more "premium" feel than 100% polyester pads, you might find the blend a bit rough to the touch initially.

It's a little thin, I use it to cushion my current desk chair and it fit well. At 4 cm thick, it’s supportive but quite firm. Not for those looking for a "cloud-like" feel. The little rubber bits on the bottom; One of its best features; it actually stays put without needing messy ties.

Here’s a smoother, more natural version of your review:

I bought the ISJAKT LED floor uplighter/reading lamp and absolutely love its sleek, slender, and stylish design. It looks beautiful in my space, and I’m very happy with my purchase overall.

reviews.author: Joey
reviews.title: Turn your room into a cozy space in seconds
reviews.text:
I’m really happy with this floor lamp! It instantly made my room feel warmer and more cozy, and the design looks very sleek and modern. The light it gives off is just right—not too harsh but bright enough to make the space comfortable and relaxing.

The only downside is the price since it’s a bit on the expensive side at S$112. That said, I still think it’s definitely worth the investment because it feels sturdy and looks great in the room. My only hope is that the reading lights were adjustable too and that the metal won’t rust over time, but so far the quality seems very good.

Overall, I’d recommend it if you’re looking for a stylish lamp that can really elevate the look of your space!

reviews.title: Good when it works, frustrating when it doesn't
reviews.text:
Bought one of these to monitor the CO2 levels in my room, however it may spontaneously miscalibrate itself to a ridiculously high level of CO2, and never correct itself again. There is no known way to forcefully recalibrate the CO2 levels, leading to a faulty product even after leaving it by a window for weeks. 

Returned my first one due to this issue, 2nd one is going back due to the same issue. Otherwise, its a very pretty and nice little addition to your desk.

reviews.title: Perfect for BTO living room or dining room
reviews.text: This was great for my HDB BTO living room. Would work for the dining room as well. At its brightest setting, it's too bright for the room but with the Styrbar dimmer, it's adjustable to all levels of brightness. It turns back on at the last brightness setting so there's no need to adjust each time. There are three brightness settings. Personally, I find the yellow light way too yellow and will not use it. The warm daylight is also on the yellower side compared to previous warm daylight lights I've used. White daylight is great for working in. All in all, it's a close competitor to the Philips panel ceiling light.
